installation: not installed; runtime and real accounts untouched
visual_note: Pure synthetic fixture; final action-column adjustment preserves original 54px switch/detail and uses 2-column quick-action grid. No live account controls were clicked.
model_mismatch: pass answer with model_mismatch is amber, explicitly not counted as selected-model pass; absent actual model shown as not provided
models_cache: Per account/API/key owner caches settled models promise, including rejection; recurring 15s poll reads local config/results only. Explicit settings Refresh models clears cache; owner changes abort and replace cache.
models_regression: 1 directory GET across initial load and 6 successful same-owner refreshes; 1 explicit directory retry, then 4 failed-cache polls with 0 retries; changed API/key owner gets separate directory.
errors: Policy blocked / paused account / globally busy / cooldown / 403 denied / generic 409 distinguished by error code and status.
zero_time: Dates earlier than 2000 are unavailable; next-due title requires enabled config and valid date.
reset_shortcut: 24px SVG ticket beside summary, disabled with hover-only reason when ineligible; opens existing confirmation with no POST; confirmed redeem reuses duplicate/uncertain guard.
concurrency_editor: Always visible compact limit input and Save row; 0 means unlimited in title and ARIA description, scoped API body unchanged.
quality_storage_error: state_error parses from Snapshot; schedule and status report storage error/paused, run disabled even via direct handler, historical bars and settings retained.
manual_multiselect: Native top-layer popover supports 1..16 manual models, select all/clear; empty disables run, POST contains all selected; saved periodic config remains unchanged. A separate history-model filter labels bars continuously.
periodic_modal: Native dialog.showModal, 520px/max80vh, scrolling content and fixed footer, collapsed question fields, ESC/backdrop/cancel close and restore focus, explicit Tab containment; current server config is cloned including low effort and new models.
multimodal_qa: Four Node suites, full bundle syntax and patch idempotence pass. Root owns one final browser functional QA; no additional screenshot loop here.
result_modal: Result detail now shares native modal helper, bounded scrollable content, ESC/backdrop close and clicked-bar focus return; no inline row expansion.
blocked_history: History requested_model values supplement failed model directory and empty config. Blocked run is disabled at UI and handler, one-line pause notice replaces duplicate directory/stale-run messages.
